summary: A tracker after BTDSys Matilde: up to 16 tracks, each a voice playing a wave from the song's wavetable with its own volume and two effect-command columns (pitch slides, tone portamento, vibrato, sample offset, volume slides, retrigger, note cut and delay); a master level, master and per-track mutes that fade over Mute Inertia, a choice of interpolation, and an output per track beside the master mix. MIDI notes play the wave track 1 last chose (wave 1 until it chooses one), on free voices from the last.
use_for: A sixteen-track tracker that plays waves from the song's wavetable.
quirks: It plays the song's wavetable: it is silent until a slot holds a wave (wave_import), and each track picks its slot with Wave.
A track's Volume is a square-law scale (amplitude = (value / 128) squared): 128 is unity, 254 about +11.9 dB.
Each track has two effect columns (Cmd and Arg, Cmd2 and Arg2) that run side by side: pitch slides, tone portamento, vibrato, sample offset, volume slides and a few fine commands.
Master is a percentage of unity: 100 percent is value 32768, up to 200 percent.
The muting parameters fade over Mute Inertia while the voices keep running, so a muted track stays in step with the song.

parameters.name: Master
parameters.description: Master output volume (0x8000 = unity). The master mix's level in % of unity (0x8000), up to 200 %; the per-track outputs leave it out
parameters.how: Sets the level of the whole machine from 0 to 200 percent; 100 is unity.
parameters.sound: Turns every track up or down together.

parameters.name: Mute
parameters.how: Mutes the whole machine, fading over Mute Inertia while the voices keep running.
parameters.sound: The sound fades out and comes back in time with the song.

parameters.name: Mute Inertia
parameters.description: Mute fade time in ms (0 = instant). 0 is a one-block fade. Its own text (the engine's Milliseconds descriptor) reads the raw value over 500, 0.0 … 1.0 ms; the code takes the raw value as ms
parameters.how: Sets how long a mute fade takes, from 0 to 500 ms.
parameters.sound: At 0 the mute is as quick as one block; longer times fade smoothly.

parameters.name: Mute Track 1
parameters.how: Mutes track 1 with a fade of Mute Inertia, while its voice keeps running.
parameters.sound: The track fades out and comes back in phase with the song.

parameters.name: Interpolation
parameters.how: Chooses how samples are read when they are played at another pitch: none, linear, cubic, B-spline or 16 or 32 point sinc.
parameters.sound: Higher quality gives cleaner highs and fewer aliasing artefacts at the cost of CPU.

track_parameters.name: Wave
track_parameters.description: Wavetable slot to play. The wave slot the track plays from its next note on; setting it sets the track's volume to unity
track_parameters.how: Chooses which wavetable slot, 1 to 200, the track plays from its next note on.
track_parameters.sound: The sample you chose plays instead of the previous one.

track_parameters.name: Volume
track_parameters.description: Track volume (0x80 = unity). The amplitude is (v / 128)²: 0x80 is unity, 0xFE +11.9 dB, 0 silent
track_parameters.how: Sets the track's volume on a square-law scale where 128 is unity and 254 is about +11.9 dB.
track_parameters.sound: Higher values play the track louder, and zero silences it.

track_parameters.name: Cmd
track_parameters.description: Effect command, first column (Matilde-style). 01/02 slide, 03 tone portamento, 04 vibrato, 09 sample offset, 0A volume slide, 0C set volume, 0E extended
track_parameters.how: Chooses the first effect command, such as a pitch slide, portamento, vibrato, sample offset or volume slide.
track_parameters.sound: The track slides, wobbles or jumps according to the command.

track_parameters.name: Arg
track_parameters.how: Gives the first effect command its argument, 0 to 254.
track_parameters.sound: Sets how fast, how deep or how far the command works.

track_parameters.name: Cmd2
track_parameters.description: Effect command, second column (runs alongside the first)
track_parameters.how: Chooses the second effect command, which runs alongside the first.
track_parameters.sound: Lets a track combine two effects, such as vibrato and a volume slide.

track_parameters.name: Arg2
track_parameters.how: Gives the second effect command its argument, 0 to 254.
track_parameters.sound: Sets how fast, how deep or how far the second command works.
